docstring: Computes valid execution order and cycle detection for task DAGs using Kahn's algorithm.
signature: def resolve_dag_order(tasks: list[str], dependencies: dict[str, list[str]]) -> dict:
ref_test:
def test_resolve_dag():
    tasks = ["build", "test", "deploy"]
    deps = {"test": ["build"], "deploy": ["test"]}
    res = resolve_dag_order(tasks, deps)
    assert not res["has_cycle"]
    assert res["execution_order"] == ["build", "test", "deploy"]
    assert res["unresolved_tasks"] == []

    # Cycle test
    tasks_c = ["A", "B"]
    deps_c = {"A": ["B"], "B": ["A"]}
    res_c = resolve_dag_order(tasks_c, deps_c)
    assert res_c["has_cycle"]
    assert res_c["execution_order"] == []
    assert set(res_c["unresolved_tasks"]) == {"A", "B"}
